test_cases.title: Production database completely down
test_cases.description: Primary Postgres instance is not accepting connections. All API requests dependent on the database are failing with 500 errors.
test_cases.notes: Total outage, obvious critical case.

test_cases.title: Payment processing API returning 500 for all requests
test_cases.description: Every checkout attempt in the last 15 minutes has failed at the payment step. No successful transactions are going through.
test_cases.notes: Direct revenue/customer impact, unambiguous.

test_cases.title: Checkout endpoint p95 latency above 5 seconds
test_cases.description: The primary checkout API endpoint has had p95 latency above 5000ms for the past 20 minutes, up from a typical 300ms baseline.
test_cases.notes: Severe degradation on a critical path, but not full outage.

test_cases.title: Internal admin dashboard showing stale cache
test_cases.description: The internal-only admin analytics dashboard is showing data that's about 10 minutes stale. No customer-facing systems affected.
test_cases.notes: Internal-only, no customer impact, clearly minor.

test_cases.title: Customer PII exposed in public S3 bucket
test_cases.description: A misconfigured S3 bucket containing customer names, emails, and addresses was found publicly accessible. Unknown how long it has been exposed.
test_cases.notes: Data breach, unambiguous critical severity.

test_cases.title: Nightly ETL job failed, downstream reports missing today's data
test_cases.description: The nightly ETL pipeline failed at 2am. All downstream business reports for today are missing the latest day of data.
test_cases.notes: Real business impact, but not customer-facing or an active outage.

test_cases.title: Typo in internal Slack bot's help message
test_cases.description: The #eng-tools Slack bot's /help command has a typo in the third bullet point of its response.
test_cases.notes: Trivial, cosmetic, no functional impact.

test_cases.title: Elevated error rate on background sync job
test_cases.description: A non-critical background sync job has a 15% error rate in the last hour, but automatic retries are eventually succeeding for all records.
test_cases.notes: Reasonable people could argue LOW (retries succeed) or MEDIUM (elevated error rate worth watching).

test_cases.title: One of three redundant cache nodes is down
test_cases.description: A single cache node in a 3-node redundant cluster has gone offline. The other two nodes are handling traffic normally, no customer impact detected yet.
test_cases.notes: Debatable LOW (redundancy is working as designed) vs MEDIUM (reduced headroom, worth fixing before another node fails).

test_cases.title: Suspicious login attempts from unfamiliar IP range
test_cases.description: Security monitoring flagged repeated login attempts from an IP range not previously associated with the account. No successful breach has been confirmed.
test_cases.notes: Debatable MEDIUM (no confirmed breach) vs HIGH (security incidents warrant caution even unconfirmed).

test_cases.title: Support ticket volume spiked 3x in the last hour
test_cases.description: Customer support has seen a 3x spike in incoming tickets over the last hour. Root cause is not yet identified.
test_cases.notes: Signal of a real problem, but severity depends on a root cause we don't have yet -- reasonable to rate MEDIUM pending investigation.

test_cases.title: Feature flag rollout increased latency for 5% of users in one region
test_cases.description: A new feature flag rollout is causing increased page load latency for approximately 5% of users, isolated to the EU region.
test_cases.notes: Limited blast radius (5%, one region) argues against HIGH, but real measurable degradation argues against LOW.

test_cases.title: Database replica lag increased to 45 seconds
test_cases.description: A read replica's lag behind the primary database has increased to 45 seconds, up from a typical 2 seconds. Primary database is unaffected.
test_cases.notes: Depends heavily on what reads from that replica -- genuinely ambiguous without more context, good test of how the system handles uncertainty.

test_cases.title: Third-party analytics vendor API intermittently timing out
test_cases.description: Our analytics vendor's API is timing out roughly 1 in 10 calls. This is non-blocking -- the app queues and retries analytics events, no user-facing impact.
test_cases.notes: Debatable LOW (non-blocking, queued) vs MEDIUM (external dependency issue worth tracking).

test_cases.title: Something seems off with checkout
test_cases.description: A few users mentioned checkout issues in support chats. No specific error, no metrics reviewed yet.
test_cases.notes: Deliberately vague -- tests whether the system defaults to a reasonable middle severity given real but unconfirmed signal, rather than over- or under-reacting.

test_cases.title: Ops dashboard graph looks weird
test_cases.description: Someone on the ops channel noted a dashboard graph 'looks off' compared to usual. No specific metric, service, or threshold named.
test_cases.notes: Almost no actionable content -- good test of whether the system inflates severity just because it sounds concerning, versus recognizing there's insufficient information.

test_cases.title: Users reporting the app feels slow today
test_cases.description: Multiple users mentioned general slowness. No specific endpoint, error, or metric identified.
test_cases.notes: Vague but plausible real signal -- tests reasonable default behavior under ambiguity.

test_cases.title: Intern accidentally ran an unknown script in production
test_cases.description: An intern ran a script against the production environment. What the script did, and its effects, are not yet known.
test_cases.notes: Tests whether the system appropriately treats unknown blast radius as a reason for caution/higher severity, rather than waiting for confirmed harm.

test_cases.title: (empty alert body)
test_cases.notes: Degenerate/malformed input -- tests graceful handling of near-empty input rather than a crash or a wildly overconfident guess. 'Correct' answer here is really 'handles it gracefully', not a specific severity.

test_cases.title: urgent!!! fix now!!!
test_cases.description: urgent!!! fix now!!! this is really bad!!!
test_cases.notes: Tests whether the system distinguishes real signal from alarming language with no actual content -- a good LLM triage system should not be swayed by tone alone.
